warera.title: Warera — A complete web OS for gaming communities
warera.summary: A complete web operating system for online gaming communities: file indexing and an API layer interconnecting multiple games and Discord, all in one place.
warera.body:
## Overview

Warera is a complete web operating system for online gaming communities. It provides a desktop-like web environment with file indexing and an API layer that interconnects multiple games and Discord, so a community can manage data, coordinate strategy and run tools from a single place. Authentication is handled through Discord, so members log in with the account they already use.

## Key Features

- Web OS environment with a desktop-like, windowed UI
- File indexing and management
- API interconnection across multiple games and Discord
- Real-time strategic dashboards for community coordination
- Discord-based single sign-on

## Target Audience

Competitive online gaming communities — clans and alliances that coordinate through Discord and need centralized tooling. The first deployment serves the WarEra España community.

## Business Opportunity

A subscription model per community, plus a white-label / multi-game model where the same web OS can be deployed for other games' communities. Discord-native distribution keeps user acquisition cost low.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router)
- **API:** tRPC (end-to-end type safety)
- **Auth:** NextAuth with Discord provider
- **Database:** MySQL with Prisma ORM
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS

travify.title: Travify — Offline Trip Budgeting & Smart Currency Routes
travify.summary: Flutter app for digital nomads: manage trip budgets offline and get clear suggestions for the best way to exchange currencies — based on your real fees and history.
travify.body:
## Overview

Travify is a cross-platform Flutter app for **digital nomads** and frequent travelers who need serious multi-currency budgeting without relying on the cloud. Everything runs **local-first** on SQLite: trips, dynamic budgets, expenses, income, currency exchanges, and charts. Official FX rates can sync optionally (at most once per day) via ExchangeRate-API when the device is online.

Built as a Computer Engineering TFG at the University of Alicante and published on the App Store (*Travel Smart, Track everything.*).

## Key Features

- Create and manage trips (past / active / future) with non-overlapping dates
- Dynamic budgets with max limit, desired target, and automatic adjustment
- Expenses and income by category — including **amortizable expenses** and **recurring income**
- Currency exchange log with real rates and commissions
- Smart suggestions for the best way to exchange currencies — even offline
- Analytics charts (pie, line, and more) for spending, income, and exchanges
- Preferences: base currency, theme, PIN lock, and 10 languages

## Finding the best currency exchange route

Changing money while traveling is rarely a straight path: banks, airports, and street exchanges all charge different rates and fees. Travify helps you choose smarter by learning from **your own past exchanges** — and it works even **without internet**.

Here is the idea, in plain terms:

1. **It remembers what you actually got** — every time you exchange money in the app, Travify notes how much you sent, how much you received, and the commission. Over time it builds a realistic picture of what those exchanges cost you.

2. **Your real history comes first** — if you already exchanged euros for dollars or yen, Travify trusts those personal results more than a generic market rate from the internet.

3. **It looks beyond a single swap** — sometimes changing money in two or three steps (for example euros → dollars → yen) leaves you with more than a direct exchange. The app explores those short chains (up to three steps).

4. **It shows you the top options** — you see the best routes ranked by how much you would end up with, including a direct exchange when that is the winner.

**A simple example:** you want to turn 100 euros into Japanese yen. Travify might suggest going through US dollars first if, based on your past fees and rates, that path beats changing euros to yen directly.

No complex setup: you keep logging your exchanges, and the recommendations get better for the way *you* travel.

## Target Audience

Digital nomads, multi-country remote workers, backpackers, and business travelers who juggle several currencies and want realistic offline tools — not generic personal-finance apps.

## Context & Opportunity

University of Alicante TFG (June 2025) with a freemium product angle: one-time unlock (~€2.99) without ads, optional tourism partnerships. Differentiator vs Mint / YNAB / PocketGuard: **true offline** plus **commission-aware multi-hop FX routing** grounded in the user's own exchange history.

## Tech Stack

- **UI / runtime:** Flutter + Dart
- **Persistence:** SQLite (`sqflite`) with DAOs
- **State:** Provider (Model–View–Service + Repository)
- **FX API:** ExchangeRate-API (optional; EUR base)
- **Charts:** Syncfusion Flutter Charts
- **i18n:** easy_localization (10 languages)
- **Other:** connectivity_plus, shared_preferences, image_picker, Lottie

algorithmPanel.title: Currency route algorithm
algorithmPanel.lead: A fully offline pipeline in ChangeService: learn from your real exchanges, build a conversion graph, then search short multi-hop paths to maximize what you receive.

steps.title: Prepare history
steps.body: Past exchanges become a historical map: origin, destination, amounts, and commission for each transaction.

steps.title: Effective rates
steps.body: For every currency pair, average the true rate you got after fees — not the sticker rate.

steps.title: Average fees
steps.body: Commission per pair is averaged from your history (default 2% if unknown), optionally blended with the fee you type now.

steps.title: EUR as pivot
steps.body: Official rates are stored only as EUR → X. Any missing A → B pair is derived through euro, cutting storage from n² pairs to n rates.

steps.title: Build the graph
steps.body: Currencies are nodes; directed edges carry a net rate. Your personal history always beats estimated official rates.

steps.title: Search & rank
steps.body: Limited-depth DFS explores routes up to 3 hops without repeating currencies, simulates an amount, and returns the top 3 paths.

priorityItems: 1 — Average effective rate from your real history for that pair
2 — Official rate estimated via the EUR pivot when no history exists
algorithmPanel.exampleLead: Convert 100 EUR → JPY. Routes ranked by destination value:
algorithmPanel.exampleFoot: The direct path is not always best: a short multi-hop route can win when fees and real rates align.

complexity.label: Route search
complexity.detail: n ≈ 31 currencies, depth d = 3 (max 3 hops). Practical on mobile.

complexity.label: Official rates store
complexity.detail: EUR pivot replaces storing all n² pairs.

complexity.label: Graph build (prev.)
complexity.detail: Fewer rates to fetch, store, and combine when deriving A→B.

complexity.label: Memory footprint
complexity.detail: History + official rates live in SQLite; search runs in device RAM.

algorithmPanel.serviceNote: Implemented in ChangeService: calcularTasasEfectivasMedias, calcularComisionMedia, construirGrafoPriorizandoReal, enumerarRutasCambio.

lesly.title: Lesly — Full-stack web app with auth & admin dashboard
lesly.summary: Multiplatform live concert streaming app with full authentication, social login, and an admin dashboard. v1 web (Laravel) and v2 mobile (Flutter), both with a Laravel backend.
lesly.body:
## Overview

Multiplatform application for live concert streaming. The first version shipped as a responsive web app with a Laravel frontend; the second version moved the client to Flutter while keeping Laravel as the backend in both iterations. Includes a complete authentication system (sign-up, login, password reset, Facebook OAuth) and an admin dashboard.

## Key Features

- **Auth + social login**: Sign-up, login, password reset, and Facebook OAuth.
- **Admin dashboard**: Content and user management for operators.
- **Responsive UI**: Web-first experience in v1; native mobile in v2.
- **Live streaming**: Concert broadcast workflows across both versions.

## Target Audience

Live-music fans, and artists or venues that want to stream and watch live concerts across web and mobile.

## Business Opportunity

Pay-per-view ticketing for live events, subscriptions, and revenue share with artists and venues.

## Tech Stack

- **Web:** Laravel (PHP)
- **Mobile app:** Flutter
- **Database:** MySQL

olvida.title: Olvida — Reduce your digital footprint
olvida.summary: Platform that helps users shrink their online footprint through automated, legally-compliant data-removal processes, always under the user's express authorization.
olvida.body:
## Overview

Olvida is a platform that helps people reduce their digital footprint on the internet. It automates data-removal and opt-out processes against third parties through legally-compliant workflows, always executed under the user's express authorization. The goal is to give individuals back control over their personal data with minimal effort on their side.

## Key Features

- Automated data-removal / opt-out workflows
- Legally-compliant processes with explicit user consent
- Clean, accessible UI built on a modern component system

## Target Audience

Privacy-conscious individuals in the EU who want to remove or limit their personal data online without doing it manually.

## Business Opportunity

A recurring subscription privacy service (in the space of Incogni or DeleteMe), with B2C recurring revenue and potential B2B use cases such as employee data offboarding.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **Components:** shadcn/ui

ebisu.title: eBISU — Sales & payments management platform
ebisu.summary: SaaS platform to manage a business's sales and payments with transaction history, analytics, ticketing, and a public API. University of Alicante project.
ebisu.body:
## Overview

SaaS platform to manage a business's sales and payments: full transaction history, advanced analytics dashboard, ticketing support, and a public API for integrations. Developed as a University of Alicante project.

## Key Features

- **Transaction history**: Complete record of sales and payment events.
- **Analytics dashboard**: Business metrics and visual insights.
- **Secure payments**: Payment processing with audit trail.
- **Public REST API**: Endpoints for third-party integrations.

## Target Audience

Small and medium businesses and merchants that need to track sales, payments and transactions with analytics in one dashboard.

## Business Opportunity

SaaS subscription tiers, with potential transaction/processing fees and paid API access for third-party integrations.

## Tech Stack

- **Backend:** Laravel (PHP)
- **Frontend:** Blade templates + jQuery
- **Database:** MySQL
- **API:** REST (public API for integrations)

tusofertasdehoy.title: TusOfertasDeHoy — Daily deals aggregator
tusofertasdehoy.summary: Web platform that aggregates and displays daily product deals and offers with affiliate links.
tusofertasdehoy.body:
## Overview

Web platform that aggregates and displays daily product deals and offers with affiliate links. Users can browse curated deals, compare prices, and follow outbound links to partner stores.

## Key Features

- **Deals listing**: Daily refreshed catalog of product offers.
- **Product cards with prices**: Structured cards with pricing and deal metadata.
- **Affiliate integration**: Outbound tracking links to partner retailers.

## Target Audience

Bargain hunters and deal seekers in Spain looking for daily curated product offers.

## Business Opportunity

Affiliate commissions (Amazon and others) plus display advertising. The n8n automation keeps content fresh at near-zero marginal cost, which makes the model scalable.

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** Next.js
- **Backend:** Node.js 18+
- **Database:** MySQL
- **Automation:** n8n (automated deal aggregation & updates)
